name: io.github.DeepCivic/sanctions-au
title: Australian sanctions screening (unofficial)
description: Unofficial: screen subjects against the DFAT Consolidated List and ABF Register of Sanctioned Sponsors from local snapshots, plus optional GLEIF LEI lookups.

environmentVariables.name: SANCTIONS_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the dataset snapshots. The image defaults to /data.

environmentVariables.name: SANCTIONS_ENABLE_GLEIF
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow the GLEIF LEI tools, which send queries to api.gleif.org. Off by default; sanctions screening never uses the network.
